specific_waiting.value: 24 months of continuous coverage (cataract, hernia, sinusitis, benign prostatic hypertrophy, etc.)

initial_waiting.value: 30 days from first policy commencement date (accidents excluded)

room_rent.value: At Actuals across all plans (Annexure C Plan Chart)

copay.value: No zonal co-payment if Tier 2 insured avails treatment in Tier 1

ayush.value: Inpatient care under Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy covered up to Policy Schedule sub-limit

daycare.value: All Day Care Treatments covered up to Sum Insured

ncb.value: Plus Benefit increases cover by 50% after 1 year and 100% after 2 years irrespective of claims; Secure Benefit adds 100%–200% from day 1

sublimits.value: No room rent or disease sub-limits on base hospitalization; Daily Cash for Shared Room ₹800–₹1,000/day
